title: 第 7章前世今生缘-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一次是运气好，连续两天都往家寻摸吃喝，秦婉拿着钱和证明，眼眶泛红，声音微微颤抖：“儿啊，你长大了，能挣钱养家了。”

    这时，一直没说话的王笑笑奶声奶气地说：“大锅，笑笑吃大驴驴。”大家听了都笑起来。

    秦婉赶忙把钱小心收好，说道：“今晚娘就给你们炖鱼。”接着又看见那个袋子，好奇地问：“大儿子，这袋子里是什么啊？”

    王野打开袋子一样一样地拿出来。罐头、水果、麦乳精，还有奶粉，每拿出一样，秦婉的眼睛就睁大一圈。

    “这，这，这都是你换的？大儿子你是钓了多少鱼呀？”

    王江河插嘴：“娘，我大哥钓了好多好多鱼呢！一下一条，一下一条。一大群人围着看呢，他们还……”

    没等他继续说，王野捂住他的嘴，这要是让他全都说了，自己这点儿家底儿得全都上交。

    秦婉瞪着王野：“你堵他嘴干什么？说！还有什么事儿瞒着我？”

    王野从兜里掏出来一部分粮票布票等，烟酒糖票是不会拿出来的。一脸惋惜地上交。秦婉拿着钱票转身就回卧房，看样子是要藏起来。

    王野眼疾手快，赶紧打开麦乳精，小跑着去厨房拿了两个碗，一气呵成，每个碗里两勺麦乳精，拿水壶倒水。看得王江河目瞪口呆，水刚倒上，秦婉就从屋里出来了，正好看见王野的操作。伸手指着王野说：“你这个败家玩意儿，老娘就转眼的功夫，你就把东西嚯嚯了。”

    王野赶紧解释道：“娘，这怎么是嚯嚯呢？我给弟弟妹妹尝尝麦乳精，你看他们瘦的。”

    秦婉也是没办法说什么了。大儿子这么懂事儿，知道疼弟弟妹妹，这应该欣慰的。可是想到好好的一瓶麦乳精就打开了，想送礼，还是换粮食都不行了。又心疼又气，冷哼了一声不说话了。

    王野没皮没脸地靠近秦婉，嬉皮笑脸地说：“娘，一会儿把两条鱼都炖了呗！”

    秦婉板着脸：“臭小子，你是要上天呀！还都炖了，吃得完吗？炖一条就行了，另一条我要做成咸鱼，要留着以后吃。”

    王野开始忽悠大法了：“娘，你想呀，咱院里的邻居，关系都不错，咱家没东西吃的时候，李奶奶、赵爷爷、刘叔哪家没给我们三个吃的呀？没多有少，都能给一口。”

    “再说了，刚才我带着鱼进门，全院都看见了，这要是咱自己在屋里关起门来吃独食儿，这以后抬头不见低头见的，多尴尬呀！”

    王野也不是什么圣母，这要是和禽兽大院似的，别说给他们吃了，不端出去馋他们就算王野仁义了。

    秦婉想了一下，应声道：“行吧！”

    王野安慰道：“娘，你放心吧！鱼是我钓的，今天我能钓到，以后我会钓的更多。”

    秦婉听了儿子的话，心里宽慰不少：“行吧！就按你说的办。”于是转身进厨房忙活起来。

    王野把一碗麦乳精端给王江河，还嘱咐着烫，慢点喝，而他抱着小丫头，用勺子一勺一勺地喂她，王野这还没盛起，小丫头就张开小嘴，还啊啊的，好像一只等着投喂的小鸟。

    宠溺地刮了一下小丫头的鼻子说：“你这小丫头片子，怎么这么可爱呀，你是吃可爱长大的吗？”

    王笑笑：“起可爱，起可爱。”

    不多会儿，鱼汤的香味就在小院里弥漫开来。秦婉将炖好的鱼盛出几大碗分给邻居。没多久王铁柱、赵爷爷和刘叔一起回到了院里。各回各家，愉快地吃了一顿美味的鱼汤。秦婉也把王野今天的壮举跟王铁柱学了一遍。

    吃完晚饭，现在是真没什么娱乐活动，真怀念电视手机呀。一家人又去门口乘凉了。看着一帮老爷们儿在那儿抽烟，侃大山，王野的烟瘾也犯了。抱起小丫头说：“走喽！哥哥带你玩去。”

    小丫头“咯咯咯”地笑着。李奶奶对着秦婉说：“小婉呀，你家几个孩子真亲呀！不像我家一天到晚净干仗。”

    听见别人夸自己家孩子，秦婉发自内心地高兴。

    抱着小丫头一路来到供销社，夏天天黑的晚，供销社八点才下班。冬天就七点半下班了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Once, she was lucky. She went home to look for food and drink for two days in a row. Qin Wan took the money and certificates, her eyes were red and her voice was trembling slightly: "My son, you have grown up and can earn money to support the family."

At this time, Wang Xiaoxiao, who had been silent, said in a sweet voice: "Big pot, Xiaoxiao eats the big donkey." Everyone laughed after hearing this.

Qin Wan hurriedly put the money away carefully and said, "My mother will stew fish for you tonight." Then she saw the bag again and asked curiously: "Eldest son, what is in this bag?"

Wang Ye opened the bag and took it out one by one.Canned food, fruits, malted milk, and milk powder. Qin Wan's eyes widened every time he took out something.

"You changed this, this, these? How many fish did you catch, eldest son?"

Wang Jianghe interrupted: "Mom, my eldest brother caught a lot of fish! One at a time, one at a time. A large group of people were watching, and they..."

Before he could continue speaking, Wang Ye covered his mouth. If he was allowed to tell everything, he would have to hand over all his family assets.

Qin Wan glared at Wang Ye: "Why are you blocking his mouth? Tell me! What else are you hiding from me?"

Wang Ye took out some food stamps, cloth stamps, etc. from his pocket. He would not take out any tobacco, alcohol or candy stamps.He handed it in with a look of regret on his face.Qin Wan took the money ticket and turned around and went back to the bedroom, apparently intending to hide it.

Wang Ye, with quick eyesight and quick hands, quickly opened the malted milk, trotted to the kitchen and got two bowls. He finished it in one go, put two spoons of malted milk in each bowl, and poured water from the kettle.Wang Jianghe was stunned. As soon as the water was poured, Qin Wan came out of the room and saw Wang Ye's operation.Pointing at Wang Ye, he said: "You wasteful thing, in the blink of an eye, you destroyed the thing."

Wang Ye quickly explained: "Mom, why is this hoho? I'll give my brothers and sisters a taste of malted milk. Look at how thin they are."

Qin Wan couldn't say anything.It should be gratifying that the eldest son is so sensible and knows how to care for his younger brothers and sisters.But thinking about a good bottle of malted milk, I opened it. I wanted to give it as a gift or exchange it for food.Feeling distressed and angry, he snorted and stopped talking.

Wang Ye approached Qin Wan shamelessly and said with a playful smile: "Mom, I'll stew both fishes in a while!"

Qin Wan said with a straight face: "You brat, you're going to heaven! You've stewed it all, can you finish it? Just stew one, and I'll make the other one into salted fish and save it for later."

Wang Ye began to lie about Dafa: "Mom, think about it, the neighbors in our courtyard are all on good terms. When our family ran out of food, which one of Grandma Li, Grandpa Zhao, and Uncle Liu didn't give the three of us something to eat? No matter how much or how little, they all gave us a bite."

"Besides, I brought the fish in just now, and the whole courtyard saw it. If we closed the door and ate alone in the house, we wouldn't be able to see each other when we looked up and looked down, how embarrassing it would be!"

Wang Ye is not a holy mother. If this is like a courtyard for animals, let alone feeding them, it would be Wang Ye's kindness not to go out to feast on them.

Qin Wan thought for a moment and responded: "Okay!"

Wang Ye comforted him: "Mom, don't worry! I caught the fish. If I can catch it today, I will catch more in the future."

After hearing what her son said, Qin Wan felt relieved: "Okay! I'll do as you say." Then she turned around and went into the kitchen to get busy.

Wang Ye brought a bowl of malted milk to Wang Jianghe, and told him to boil it and drink it slowly. He held the little girl and fed her spoonful by spoonful. Before Wang Ye could fill it up, the little girl opened her small mouth and returned the food, like a little bird waiting to be fed.

He scratched the little girl's nose lovingly and said, "Why are you so cute, little girl? Did you grow up eating cuteness?"

Wang Xiaoxiao: "It's cute, it's cute."

After a while, the aroma of fish soup filled the small courtyard.Qin Wan took out several large bowls of stewed fish and distributed them to the neighbors.Not long after, Wang Tiezhu, Grandpa Zhao and Uncle Liu returned to the courtyard together.Everyone went back to their respective homes and happily had a delicious fish soup.Qin Wan also learned from Wang Tiezhu Wang Ye's feat today.

After dinner, there are really no entertainment activities now. I really miss the TV and mobile phone.The family went to the door to enjoy the cool air again.Seeing a bunch of old men smoking and chatting there, Wang Ye got addicted to smoking.He picked up the little girl and said, "Let's go! Brother will take you to play."

The little girl giggled.Grandma Li said to Qin Wan: "Xiao Wan, your children are so close! It's not like my family who fights all day long."

Qin Wan felt happy from the bottom of her heart when she heard others praise her children.

I carried the little girl all the way to the supply and marketing cooperative. It gets dark late in the summer, and the supply and marketing cooperative doesn’t get off work until eight o’clock.I get off work at 7:30 in winter.
